· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0008 → -0.0026) — weakness persists, bearish divergence after dead cross.

· Swing resistance ($0.18) — near SMA5/20/50 and 5-day high, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.00x) — moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — consider buying after confirmation of support at $0.16.
